summary.text: Rob Harris is a Republican state representative from South Carolina House District 36 who has served since November 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Rob Harris lives in Wellford, South Carolina, and his career experience includes working as a registered nurse.
He founded ActionSC.org and has served as a Republican Precinct Executive Committeeman.
Harris assumed office on November 14, 2022, succeeding Merita Ann Allison.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Agriculture, Natural Resources and Environmental Affairs Committee, after serving on the Medical, Military, Public and Municipal Affairs Committee in 2023-2024.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
